name: n4_histories_audit
description: Audit the histories of the connected station below base, in one read-only call (station-audits S1). It lists: no_history, the control points with no history extension right below them ({point}); disabled, the history extensions whose enabled is false ({ext, history_id}); stale, the enabled histories whose last record is older than stale_factor x the collection interval (interval histories) or than cov_max_age (COV histories), or that never recorded ({history_id, ext, last_record ISO-8601 or null, interval as a span such as 5m or cov, threshold, age, note}); near_capacity, the histories capped by record count holding at least capacity_warn of it ({history_id, ext, records, capacity, fraction, full_policy, severity, effect}: severity warning for full policy stop, where recording stops when full, info for roll, where the oldest records are overwritten); and colliding_ids, the history ids two or more extensions record into ({history_id, exts}). Each list keeps at most 100 items; counts holds the totals (points, history_exts and one per list). It reads select slotPath, type, enabled, historyConfig.id, historyConfig.capacity, fullPolicy, interval and lastRecord.timestamp (each as encodeToString) from history:HistoryExt (at most max_histories rows) and select slotPath from control:ControlPoint, then one select count(*) per distinct record-capped history id that has recorded (count_reads; requests is the total). truncated is true when a read stopped at its cap: then no_history is not checked (counts.no_history null, no_history_note says why). not_answered counts cells the station answered in no known form, per column; notes say what was left out. Read-only: fixed queries.

base.description: Slot ORD of the folder to audit, itself and below, e.g. station:|slot:/Drivers (default: the whole station)

stale_factor.description: An interval history is stale when its last record is older than this many collection intervals

cov_max_age.description: A COV history is stale when its last record is older than this span: 30m, 24h, 7d

capacity_warn.description: Fraction of a record-count capacity from which a history is near capacity

max_histories.description: Most history extensions read (and record counts read)

timeout_s.description: HTTP timeout per request in seconds
